about: Recurring cast of the ted-MG motion graphics Shorts (format "tedmg"). Drawn by shorts/design_kit/tedmg-kit.jsx (MGBust / MGPerson / MGHead with who=<id>) — never redraw a cast member by hand. Background people: MG.extra(i). Append each episode to the character's history.
style: Flat-vector cartoon: big round cream heads, dot eyes with expressive brows, thick ink outlines, warm muted scenes. White + amber condensed captions. Reference: shorts/styles/tedmg/.

milo.name: Milo
milo.look: tall dark quiff, white button shirt
milo.personality: self-conscious and kind; sure everyone is watching and judging him; funny when he relaxes
history: ep 1 (milo-coffee-stain): spotlight effect — coffee stain at the party, nobody noticed; tomorrow he gives a speech

nia.name: Nia
nia.look: black curly hair, mustard top, deep skin tone
nia.personality: confident, practical, blunt; the one who says 'nobody saw it, Milo'
history: ep 1 (first-impressions, with Rosa): "they'll judge your face first"

theo.name: Theo
theo.look: short grey hair, round glasses, green cardigan
theo.personality: dry humour, retired teacher; explains the psychology with a story

rosa.name: Rosa
rosa.personality: ambitious people-pleaser; says yes to everything, then panics
history: ep 1 (first-impressions): rehearsed 40 interview answers; learns faces are judged in 0.1 s and the halo effect, bins the script and smiles at the receptionist first

dev.name: Dev
dev.look: buzz cut, full beard, blue top, brown skin
dev.personality: laid-back gym coach and confident talker; overestimates himself (Dunning–Kruger material)
history: ep 1 (doodlers, with June): sat perfectly still in the meeting and went blank; now doodles sharks

june.name: June
june.look: ginger bun, round glasses, teal top
june.personality: anxious student and planner; procrastinates, then overprepares
history: ep 1 (doodlers): doodling — June spirals through the meeting, Dev says she is not listening, but she is the one who remembers (Andrade 2009); next meeting Dev doodles sharks
